tools.name: compare_texas_electricity_plans
tools.description: Ranks the Texas retail electricity plans available at a ZIP code by projected yearly cost at the person's own monthly kWh (not the 1,000 kWh average plan ads use). Free, no account. Returns the cheapest plans with their Electricity Facts Label links and a link that reopens the same comparison on ele

tools.name: how_to_get_my_usage
tools.description: How a Texas household gets 12 months of electricity usage (kWh) for compare_texas_electricity_plans: Smart Meter Texas download, bills, or one typical month. Also explains when monthly numbers are enough.
